title.narrative: Tuberculosis ("TB") interventions among refugees in Eastern Africa - Eastern Africa - Multicountry Eastern Africa IGAD (01-Apr-2022-31-Mar-2025)

description.narrative: Multicountry Eastern Africa IGAD, Tuberculosis, Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD)This program has the following goals: To contribute to ending TB in the region by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To Strengthen capacity for TB and MDR-TB diagnosis and TB (TB/HIV) service provision in refugee camps including cross border health facilities. To strengthen in-country and cros border collaboration of NTPs/NAPs for improved TB (and TB/HIV) service provision among refugees.. To address policy barriers and related national support to TB and MDR-TB services for refugees in the region

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for QPA-T-IGADP02
Outcome indicators targets and results for QPA-T-IGADP02
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for QPA-T-IGADP02
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of TB patients with DST result for at least Rifampicin among the total number of notified (new and retreatment) cases in the same year
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
